cd /workspace
echo "=== repeat protected call 3x to confirm deterministic 503 ==="
for i in 1 2 3; do
TOK=$(curl -s -m 20 -X POST "http://localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution/protocol/openid-connect/token" -H "Host: auth.localhost" -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=backend&client_secret=cVBGgWNlbwSLydLZfZMvTvmNCeiSmLGP" | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>console.log(JSON.parse(s).access_token))")
printf "attempt %s: token=%s chars -> " "$i" "${#TOK}"; curl -s -m 20 -w "[%{http_code}]\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" http://localhost:3000/api/v1/info/services
done
echo "=== public info endpoint (no auth needed) works ==="
